title: Pre-Analysis — Approach Capability Installation Extended to the Remaining Twin-Engine Fleet
abstract: Closed work order on extending the multi-mode receiver and crown aerial installation to the aircraft that never took it. The extension was rejected as scoped because the crown real estate is no longer free.

sections.objective: Assess whether the multi-mode receiver and crown aerial installation can be offered to the remaining SOLANO-30, SOLANO-34, SOLANO-38 and SOLANO-39 aircraft as a straight effectivity extension, on the same aerial position and the same loadable configuration, ahead of the approach capability mandate dates two operators have raised. The work order had to confirm the crown structural provision is still available and that the receiver interface to the flight control and guidance computers is unchanged.
sections.findings_summary: The extension cannot be offered as written. The broadband connectivity candidate takes the same crown adapter plate part and the same upper fuselage zone, and its radome footprint overlaps the aerial position this installation depends on; whichever is embodied first denies the other the real estate. That alone would have forced a rework. Two further items reinforce it. The parts figure carries the aerial installation as a single hardware and software set, so an alternative aerial position is not expressible without a new figure and a new loadable part reference. The guidance configuration standard now in pre-analysis changes the interface the receiver reports through, which means the loadable configuration referenced by this installation would be frozen against a standard the fleet is leaving.
sections.next_steps: Reject the extension as scoped and re-raise it against a revised crown arrangement agreed with the connectivity candidate team, with one adapter plate serving both installations. Ask navigation systems for the receiver interface position against the new guidance standard before any revised scope is priced, and hold the parts figure unchanged until the aerial position is settled. Inform both operators that the mandate dates are achievable only on the revised arrangement.

tasks.title: Confirm the crown structural provision is still unallocated
Check the receiver interface against current guidance standards
Review the aerial installation figure for an alternative position

expected_findings.rationale: The connectivity candidate uses the same crown adapter plate and the same upper fuselage zone, and its radome footprint covers the aerial position this installation relies on. The two documents share no vocabulary at all — one is a navigation document, the other a cabin systems document — and only the plate part number and the zone connect them.
expected_findings.resolution: Agree a single crown arrangement with one adapter plate serving both installations before any revised scope is priced.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure carries the receiver, the aerial, the adapter plate and the loadable reference as one set at one position. An alternative aerial position is not expressible in it without a new figure, which makes the revised scope larger than an effectivity change.
expected_findings.resolution: Hold the figure unchanged until the aerial position is settled.

evidence.similarity_note: Linked through the avionics rack zone and returned again by similarity on the guidance configuration and protection level wording shared by the two texts.

expected_findings.rationale: The guidance configuration standard now in pre-analysis changes the fault word alignment the receiver reports through. Extending this installation would freeze its loadable configuration against a standard the fleet is in the process of leaving.
expected_findings.resolution: Obtain the receiver interface position against the new guidance standard before re-raising the scope.

expected_findings.rationale: The installation task gives the aerial position by station and stringer against the present crown arrangement. Any revised arrangement rewrites it, and the task is also the entry point for the connectivity candidate's own installation.
expected_findings.resolution: Hold pending the crown arrangement decision, then rewrite once for both installations.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares the avionics rack zone and appears on every guidance-related search because it discusses fault attribution between computers. It isolates a primary computer fault to the wrong line replaceable unit and never touches the receiver, its aerial or its loadable configuration.

type_data.conclusion: The extension is rejected as scoped. The crown real estate is contested and the loadable configuration is about to move; a revised scope on an agreed crown arrangement is the way forward.
